source_text: Exite de arca, tu et uxor et filii et uxores filiorum, et omnia animalia. Diversitas in ecclesia: alii mansueti, alii feri fide mansuescendi. Unum baptisma, non unus profectus — unusquisque in suo ordine.
pass_a_gloss: Go-out from ark, you and wife and sons and wives of-sons, and all animals. Diversity in church: some tame, some wild by-faith to-be-tamed. One baptism, not one progress — each in own order.
pass_b_english: [[Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons’ wives, and all the animals >> Bible:Genesis 8:16-17]]. Diversity in the church: some already gentle, some still wild and to be tamed by faith. [[One baptism >> Bible:Ephesians 4:5]], yet not one and the same progress — [[each in his own order >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:23]].
